agency_id.description: Resolved platform agency identity (null when no buyer was published or resolvable).

agency_name.description: The buying organisation as published; the value `agency_id` is resolved from.

close_date.description: The tender period end — the date that makes a notice "active".

content.description: The composed narrative label; NULL on 100% of platform facts until 2026-08-28.

external_id.description: The source-native tender key: AUSTENDER `ocid`/`id` (`ausatm-…`), TENDERLINK/WESTERN_POWER namespaced `source_id`, TAS synthesised `notice_id`, VIC/SA/WA/NSW/VENDOR_PANEL `reference`/`notice_id`/`url` fallback.

occurred_at.description: The tender event the fact is dated by: OCDS release `date`/`published_date`, TENDERLINK `release_date`, WESTERN_POWER `close_date`.

ocid.description: The OCDS contracting-process identity, kept as PROVENANCE (lookup, citation, lifecycle-linker input), not an axis.

platform_project_id.description: Resolved civil-project tracking id (the primary coordinate; may be a minted stub).

procurement_method.description: The procurement method where the source publishes one.

published_date.description: The notice's publication date; equals `occurred_at` for most sources.

region.description: Tenderlink's free-text region, distinct from the derived jurisdiction.

region_code.description: The jurisdiction that published the tender.

status.description: The source's tender status (e.g. AusTender `active`, Tenderlink status).

submission_url.description: The submission portal URL where the source publishes one.

title.description: The tender notice title — the human label for the release.

value_aud.description: Estimated/budget tender value — the one declared measure.
